meta.description: Two inferential experiments on French sentences with a presupposition trigger (a definite description, a factive verb or a change-of-state predicate) in the scope or the restrictor of a quantifier, with the universal inference, that every individual of the domain satisfies the presupposition, as the conclusion to be judged. Experiment 1 collected binary judgments about the scope of 'each', 'no', 'less than 3', 'more than 3' and 'exactly 3' over a domain of 10 students; Experiment 2 collected graded judgments over a domain of 20 students for more quantifiers and for triggers in the restrictor. Per-quantifier results are printed only as bar charts (Figs. 4 and 7) and are not recorded; the text prints the pooled acceptance rates recorded here.
